claimed_state: Private owned exact PCHIP preparation input and full stamp/content matching. No qualified curve, restart or physical provider.

verification.independent_reference: Boost cpp_rational exact comparisons with source definitions and ordered fixtures; tolerance 0. Coefficient and boundary checks consume only the owned sample and policy views.
verification.ownership_and_identity: Borrow/workspace/plan destruction, moved-from rejection, separately owned equal content, zero-valued strong stamps, issuer/generation mismatch, changed sample time/value, dimension, policy, demand ends and events. Low-word exact differences tested with 2^-200. Keeps outside-demand declared events and does not invent events for knots.
verification.input_validation: Strictly increasing canonical time and event sequences, closed demand order, canonical explicit positive period equal to knot width; absent or purely low-word wrong periods rejected. Bad sample shape or noncanonical words are rejected.
verification.resource_controls: Forecast makes zero allocation attempts. Seven whole-call allocations, fault injection at each, one-less budgets for bits, work, slots and bytes, last-allocation cancellation, reentry and retry with old owners preserved. Equality makes zero allocations, checks exact/one-less work and agrees under 1/2/4 threads.
